products.name: Automation Anywhere
products.note: Intelligent automation platform; AI-powered bots; control room governance; credential vault

profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere describes itself as a provider of agentic process automation, combining AI, robotic process automation, and broader automation capabilities into a platform intended for enterprise-scale, mission-critical processes. The company positions its offering as a system that orchestrates AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers, and it markets a component called the Mozart Orchestrator as the coordination layer for these elements. Its platform also includes a control room for governance and a credential vault for security.

The company's tracked product is its core intelligent automation platform, which incorporates AI-powered bots and is delivered as a cloud or enterprise deployment. Automation Anywhere also offers a free Cloud Community Edition for individuals looking to begin automating without a paid license. The site describes use cases that include IT service management, where the company says its agentic AI can boost employee self-service, reduce IT service desk workload, predict major incidents through AIOps, and lower costs.

The site cites a Gartner finding, presented without a specific date, that more than 90 percent of self-described agentic AI solutions are repackaged generative AI layered on legacy systems, and that only around 130 vendors among thousands are delivering genuine agent-driven orchestration, a framing the company uses to position itself within that smaller group. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Automation Anywhere.
